nosotros.title: One point of accountability, from the CFE bill to commissioning.
nosotros.description: We integrate technology, engineering and financing so your company's energy transition is a business decision, not a gamble.
story: The Blvck Stone was born to solve a problem we saw repeat across hundreds of projects: the technology existed, but it arrived without local engineering, without support and without a financial structure that made it viable.
So we integrated all three. We design the technical solution from your load curve, install and commission it with our own team in Mexico, and finance it so the savings pay for the investment.

Behind every project is a network of manufacturers and specialists we select and coordinate as one team. That lets us guarantee supply, pricing and lead times across energy, mobility, construction and finance, with a single point of accountability.

sections.heading: Data controller
sections.body: The Blvck Stone, located in Polanco, Mexico City, is responsible for processing your personal data under Mexico's Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP).

sections.heading: Data we collect
sections.body: Through the contact form we collect your name, email, phone, industry and the message you choose to send. We do not request sensitive data.

sections.heading: Purposes
sections.body: We use your data to answer your request, prepare technical and commercial proposals, and follow up on the business relationship. We do not use it for other purposes without your consent.

sections.heading: Your rights (ARCO)
sections.body: You can access, rectify, cancel or object to the processing of your data by writing to contacto@the-blvckstone.com. We handle requests within the legal timeframes.

sections.heading: Transfers
sections.body: We do not transfer your data to third parties except by legal obligation or to providers operating under confidentiality agreements to deliver the service (hosting and email delivery).

sections.heading: Changes to this notice
sections.body: Any change to this notice will be published on this page with its update date.

sections.heading: Use of the site
sections.body: The content of this site is informational. Specifications, prices and financing conditions are confirmed in writing in each proposal.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: Trademarks, logos and content belong to The Blvck Stone or its licensors and may not be reproduced without authorization.

sections.heading: Liability
sections.body: We work to keep information current but do not guarantee it is error-free. Contractual obligations are defined only in signed agreements.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Mexican States.

sections.heading: What they are
sections.body: Cookies are small files the browser stores to remember preferences and measure site usage.

sections.heading: Which ones we use
sections.body: Technical cookies required for the site to work and, with your consent, analytics cookies to understand how it is used.

sections.heading: How to control them
sections.body: You can block or delete cookies from your browser settings. Some features may stop working correctly.
